dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit jagged, high-contrast light-colored perimeters with sharp pixel gradients transitioning from dark exterior margins to high-intensity interior centers across the mid-lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of amorphous high-intensity pixel clusters observed near the ventral-lateral boundary and cervical region, characterized by uniform intensity without internal gradient structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most prominent dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an irregular polygonal configuration with acute angles defining the relationship between the three most anterior structures.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, non-geometric high-intensity diffuse patch is visible on the posterior-most section of the visible pelt.
